newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen extending fall on flood fears.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen extending fall on flood fears.

text.p: The Polish bourse was expected to fall for the third session running on Tuesday as some players continued to sell in view of the current flooding in southern Poland.
Analysts said other investors might prefer to wait for more details on the damage before selling and that the market could recover by the end of the week.
Some said the bourse might accept the government's proposal to lift the budget deficit slightly to help afflicted regions.
Gorazdze, Polifarb Wroclaw, Rafako, ZEW and the parallel market's Viscoplast remain suspended due to the flooding.
